name: Browser Login
description: Log in with a login saved in this workspace's vault without seeing the password; it fills only on that login's own site. list: the saved logins and which fit this page. login: fill one into user_ref and/or pass_ref from the last read. code: fill its current 2FA code into ref. ask (on the sign-in page, when none is saved): returns a card where the user saves one; put it in your reply and end the reply. Some logins wait for the user's OK first. Never ask for a password in the chat.
author: anything

examples.prompt: (on GitHub's sign-in page, and the list has no login for github.com)

user_ref.description: login: the username or email field's ref (e12).

submit.description: Press Enter in the last field filled.
